name: flyrank-capstone-metering-billing
postCreateCommand: pip install -r requirements.txt && curl -s https://packages.stripe.dev/api/security/keypair/stripe-cli-gpg/public | gpg --dearmor | sudo tee /usr/share/keyrings/stripe.gpg > /dev/null && echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/stripe.gpg] https://packages.stripe.dev/stripe-cli-debian-local stable main' | sudo tee -a /etc/apt/sources.list.d/stripe.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y stripe
